2607.08539.title: DocMaster: A Hierarchical Structure-Aware System for Document Analysis
2607.08539.paper_summary: Leveraging large language models (LLMs) to analyze complex documents -- such as academic papers, technical manuals, and financial reports -- has emerged as a mainstream and critical task in both research and industry. In practice, users must first filter relevant documents from large collections and then conduct in-depth analysis (e.g. question answering) over the selected subset, yet existing systems flatten documents into plain-text chunks, discarding the rich hierarchical structures (sections, tables, figures, equations) and degrading downstream performance. We present DocMaster, a hierarchical structure-aware document analysis system. DocMaster parses documents into hierarchical document trees preserving original layouts and constructs a structure-aware semantic index that enables accurate document filtering and in-depth analysis. We demonstrate DocMaster through an interactive web interface that enables users to upload document collections, construct tree-based and multi-view semantic indices, filter relevant documents via natural-language conditions, and perform follow-up question answering over the filtered results. The source code, data, and demo are available at https://doc-master.github.io/.
2607.08539.paper_summary_zh: 利用大型語言模型（LLMs）來分析複雜文檔——例如學術論文、技術手冊和財務報告——已成為研究和產業中的主流且關鍵的任務。<lb/>在實踐中，用戶必須首先從大量資料中篩選出相關文檔，然後對所選子集進行深入分析（例如問答），然而現有系統將文檔扁平化為純文本塊，丟棄了豐富的層次結構（章節、表格、圖形、方程式），並降低了下游性能。<lb/>我們提出了DocMaster，一個具有層次結構感知的文檔分析系統。<lb/>DocMaster將文檔解析為保留原始佈局的層次文檔樹，並構建一個結構感知的語義索引，實現準確的文檔篩選和深入分析。<lb/>我們通過一個互動式網頁介面展示DocMaster，該介面使用戶能夠上傳文檔集合，構建基於樹的和多視圖的語義索引，通過自然語言條件篩選相關文檔，並對篩選結果進行後續問答。<lb/>源代碼、數據和演示可在 https://doc-master.github.io/ 獲得。
